title: Power Apps: header and navigation refresh for model-driven apps
summary: Hold: the licensing field says entitlement is unpublished even though Microsoft's licensing FAQ establishes the premium use rights required for model-driven apps. The control path also starts inside the app designer without explaining how to open the app for editing. The rollout facts and descriptions of the refreshed experience are supported.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The refresh is maker-opt-in for existing apps, represented as user-opt-in, with Plan designer apps identified separately.
claims.quote: The header and navigation refresh automatically applies to all apps generated by the Plan designer. For other existing apps, opt in by following these steps:

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown: entitlement to the refresh is not yet published.
claims.quote: Model-driven apps use Dataverse and are premium apps by default. Every user who runs a model-driven app needs a license that provides Power Apps premium use rights.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Retain the notes stating that model-driven app use requires a licence providing Power Apps premium use rights and that an additional requirement specific to the refresh is not published. The product-level entitlement is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-licensing-faq; an unpublished refresh-specific requirement does not make that entitlement unknown.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Power Apps (maker) > App designer > Settings > Features > Header and navigation refresh is the complete route to the app control.
claims.quote: Select Solutions. ... Choose the solution that contains the model-driven app where editing is required. ... On the left navigation pane select Apps, select a model-driven app, and then on the toolbar select Edit.
claims.fix: Replace the path in controls[0].ui and the rendered table with 'Solutions > solution > Apps > app > Edit > Settings > Features > Header and navigation refresh'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-app to sources for the entry route; retain https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/user/modern-fluent-design as docs for the control's final steps. The current path starts inside an app without the navigation and Edit operation needed to reach its designer.
